tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Live check whether domains are free to register, with prices (EUR) for 1-3 years and a cart link. Works for .al, .com.al, .net.al, .org.al, .edu.al and international extensions sold by Host.al (.com, .net, .org, .eu, .io ...). Up to 10 domains per call.

tools.name: get_domain_prices
tools.description: Registration and transfer prices (EUR) per extension, and who may register each .al extension (e.g. .al: anyone from any country; .com.al: Albanian companies or foreign brands via free local presence).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Host.al products with EUR prices, billing cycle, specs, location and order link: VPS (Tirana, Skopje, Kansas City), dedicated servers (Tirana, Skopje, Thessaloniki, Nuremberg, Kansas City), colocation in Tirana, IP transit 1/10 Gbps, free BGP session for your ASN, IPv4 lease, web hosting, SSL, Excha

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: A link that opens the Host.al cart (my.host.al) with a domain registration/transfer or a product already added. Give it to the user: they sign in and pay there.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Answers from Host.al support (help centre): .al domains (registration, AKEP approval, transfers, EPP codes, owner changes), DNS and nameservers, web hosting (Plesk), email, SSL, VPS (VirtFusion panel, reinstall, SSH, traffic, IPs, port 25, BGP), dedicated servers (delivery, iDRAC/IPMI), colocation,

tools.name: get_help_topic
tools.description: All questions and answers of one help centre topic, or the list of topics when no topic is given. Topics: domains, dns-nameservers, hosting, email, ssl, vps, dedicated-servers, colocation, billing-payments, account-security, general.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Facts about Host.al: accreditation (AKEP, ICANN), number of .al domains, datacenter in Tirana, network AS213683 and peering, locations, certifications, contact and support.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_help, get_help_topic · Private data: search_help, get_company_info · Public sink: search_help, get_help_topic.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_help, get_help_topic · Private data: search_help, get_company_info · Public sink: search_help, get_help_topic

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
